name: Leonard
source:
"My job is to fix your hair. Putting it up~ letting it down~ hiding all the sloppy places~ Yes It's all done!"

Born in France.
Hobby: Moving House
Likes: Clean and Hygienic People.
Dislikes: Unclean People and Places

[url=/c50768]Marie Antoinette's[/url] hairdresser. 
He loves beautiful men and making rankings of them, the type of person who says everything bluntly.
He used to be in charge of costuming and hairdressing opera singers, but now he works in the palace taking care of all the noble ladies.
He's confident of the way he came up this far from being a commoner.
